description: A live source-derived LiDAR/camera survey: keep linked oriented 3D cuboids fitted to concurrently moving and turning toy scans.

metadata.variant_count_kind: seeded cuboids, scan returns and nonrepeating 3D paths

name: Surveyors Toybox V2 · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Link each tug portrait to its matching camera subject. Fit its 3D cuboid using both camera plates and the sparse scan. Start the live survey, then keep every cuboid centered, sized and oriented on its moving tug until the simultaneous-fit bar fills. The active scan lasts at most 90 seconds. Calibration links and volume edits are reversible. Start commits the camera links; wrong links end the episode. Brief tracking slips remain correctable, and each lost-track bar refills when its tug is fitted again. Ten continuous seconds lost, unfinished scan expiry, or incomplete certification ends the episode. Certify is a final submission, including before Start. A later reset or submission cannot undo a failed episode. The motion trail and dotted forecast labelled on the camera are visible guidance; boxes never automatically follow a toy. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or hidden implementation state. Do not interact with pre-existing, unrelated, blank, browser-settings, or non-task tabs. A tab opened by a visible task control is allowed only if it is part of this task and only its visible controls may be used.
